items.title: David Murray interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, September 18, 2003
items.q: I probably will do a recording with Taj Mahal and Ishmael Reed

ctx.x: Well what’s in the near future for you? I know you’re mixing another album.

Well the near future is to mix this album. I’m playing Carnegie Hall on the fourteenth with my quartet with strings so I’m using ten — this time I’m using ten string players from New York. I hope they execute as well as the Cubans. I’m going to do this gig in Seattle I have to waste my time on doing. I probably will do a recording with Taj Mahal and Ishmael Reed, another Gwo-Ka with Kip Hanrahan. I think that’s on the books for October. November and December I’ll just probably be doing some gigs with the Gwo- Ka…
Maybe so. We’d be happy to have him. Well it’s been fascinating talking to you and having you on campus.
